study: Capsule Review — additional two negative-label fitting examinations in fixed pooled compact-CNN examination CV
status: Frozen before optimization, after correcting acquisition provenance. Exploratory, previously examined model outcomes and fitting exam labels are known; not new independent or clinical evaluation.
question: Does including source-verified 512 images from each additional blood-negative-annotated fitting examination 22 and 24 improve cross-examination blood-label ranking compared with the identical previously frozen 14-examination pooled weighted CNN fitted for exactly 384 optimizer steps?

source.original_image_sha_policy: All ten previously validated source packages re-hashed per original image; independently verified new 22/24 source package must match its receipt and all 1024 source PNG bytes. Reject duplicate source identity/actual image hash, invalid PNG, changed reference role or protected exams.
source.reserved_exams: Original 9-10 previously inspected; future 11-20 and authors 61-80 strictly unopened

comparison.baseline: Existing published frozen original pooled_weighted from-scratch compact CNN trained on original fitting pool, in docs/GALAR_EXAM_CV_SPEC.json. Never change baseline scores/checkpoints.
comparison.treatment: Same code/architecture, seed 37, AdamW lr=0.0002 weight_decay=0.0001, 384 updates, batch size 32, per-fold inverse-frequency class weights, uniform fitting-frame sampling with replacement, no augmentation. Only source images from training-only examinations 22 and 24 are added to fitting pool.
comparison.heldout_set: Exactly the original 14 fitting-candidate examinations with their 512 label-blind reference source positions each, while whole examination is excluded from that fold's fitting. Exams 22 and 24 NEVER evaluated in this experiment; fitting-only across all folds.
comparison.model: Fresh 3-conv GroupNorm/ReLU 2-output AnatomyCNN(2) random seed=37 at each fold, CPU float32 torch threads2, torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True), exactly last update, no pretrained checkpoint or model selection.
comparison.primary: Per-examination ROC-AUC and descriptive macro AUC among six exams with >=10 reference blood positives (1,7,25,27,29,30), paired with immutable original pooled results; negative results equally reported.
comparison.secondary: All 14 per-examination AUC/AP, including null for three blood-negative-labelled original reference exams 3,5,8 and unreliable 1-9-positive exams; at fixed K=51/128/256/512 top-image positive hits versus unchanged original pooled and uniform.
comparison.reproducibility: Refit/re-score from source original image bytes; independently reload all checkpoints and match all 7168 reference-image scores and 56 K summaries; save all original weights/predictions and source-frame identities privately.
comparison.decision: No model promotion, threshold optimization, architecture search, or protected-cohort access based on results. Explain whether new exam diversity helps, hurts, or is mixed on already examined fitting studies.

limitations: An image with blood=0 may contain other pathology; source intervals do not identify lesions, patients or elapsed capture time. Source data already inspected, no prospective independence or clinical validation. Extra negative images change training population and train-only class weights; this is not a single-variable pixel-appearance causality test.
artifacts: Commit frozen spec, reproducible source-verified fitting script, aggregate and tests only. No medical pixels, private per-image metadata/scores, trained weights, or original image paths in Git.
